newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 19.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Government to cut public works spending by more than 15 percent annually for the three fiscal years from April 1998.
-- Mitsubishi Corp freezes plan to list its shares in New York.
-- Justice Ministry eyes new legal aid system for low income earners.
-- Corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike brought two billion yen to Nomura Securities Co Ltd, and demanded a discretionary account.
-- Health and Welfare Ministry to set up study group on prenatal diagnosis.
-- Arrested corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike frequently attended Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd's shareholders' meetings.
